name: codex-micro-vscode
description: Lets the Codex Micro macropad (via codexbridge --target vscode) drive editor tabs and agent terminals: focus a pinned tab, approve/reject Claude diffs, and send keys to Codex/Kimi CLIs.

colors.description: Codex Micro idle agent tab color.
Codex Micro working agent tab color.
Codex Micro completed agent tab color.
Codex Micro needs-input agent tab color.
Codex Micro failed agent tab color.

codexMicro.socketPath.description: Unix socket the extension listens on for codexbridge. Empty uses $TMPDIR/codexbridge-vscode.sock (falls back to /tmp).

codexMicro.terminalApprove.description: Text sent to an agent TERMINAL target on an Approve press (Codex/Kimi CLIs). Use \n for Enter.

codexMicro.terminalReject.description: Text sent to an agent TERMINAL target on a Reject press.

codexMicro.terminalSubmit.description: Text sent to an agent TERMINAL target on a Submit (Codex key) press.

codexMicro.decorateTabs.description: Color pinned file-editor tab labels from SidePulse agent status. Selected tabs keep the normal VS Code selected color.
